description: Unit tests for LogUtil class in the akka utils service, testing MDC enhancement and removal functionalities using Mockito and AssertJ.

classes.name: LogUtilTest
classes.description: Test class for LogUtil, verifying MDC manipulation methods such as enhanceLogWithCorrelationId and enhanceLogWithCustomField.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Static initialization creating default MDC map with keys and values.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a mocked DiagnosticLoggingAdapter and sets up default MDC behavior.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests that the correlation ID is added to the MDC.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdRemovesEmptyId
methods.description: Ensures that null correlation ID results in MDC being reset to default.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdAndAdditionalMdcField
methods.description: Checks that an additional MDC field is added along with correlation ID.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCustomField
methods.description: Verifies that a custom field is added to MDC.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCustomFieldRemovesNullField
methods.description: Tests that null value causes the MDC field to be removed.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCustomFieldRemovesEmptyField
methods.description: Tests that empty string value causes the MDC field to be removed.

methods.name: removeCustomField
methods.description: Ensures specified MDC field is removed.

methods.name: newMdcField
methods.description: Creates a new MDC field object with given name and value.
